description: Creates or updates service territories. Territories are matched by ItemId only; an existing territory takes only the members given. List parent territories before their children.

items.description: A service territory: an area served together, drawn as a shape, listed as postal codes, or both.

ItemId.description: The territory's id. When it matches a stored territory, that territory is updated with the members given here; otherwise a new territory is created, keeping this id when it is a valid id so other records that point at it still do.

ParentId.description: The ItemId of the territory it is part of.

Shape.description: The shape, as GeoJSON text: a Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection.

PostalCodes.description: The postal codes; one ending with * matches every code that starts with the rest.

TimeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone; null for the site's.

TravelSpeedKmh.description: The average travel speed in km/h; null for the site's.

items.description: A team or person that serves the territory.

Kind.description: The kind of member, by the module that owns it, such as Team or Worker.

Id.description: The member's identifier in the module that owns it.

Role.description: Whether the territory is theirs first or as a backup.

Members.description: The people and teams that serve it.
